_comment: Persona → design tendency mapping. The 7 personas mirror data/eval/personas.json (also used as the Lowe's mock-shopper roster in data/mockLowesData.json). For each, we document: what they likely care about, common style pulls, finish bias, budget posture, and a one-sentence voice cue the agent can adopt. The agent uses these as soft priors — never as hard categorization.

first_home_couple.label: Newlywed / first-home couple
first_home_couple.budget_posture: stretching but careful — every dollar visible
first_home_couple.voice_cue: first home — they want it to feel like theirs without overspending. Anchor on one bold piece (vanity OR finish family), keep the rest restrained.

family_with_kids.label: Family with young kids
family_with_kids.voice_cue: kids in the house — surfaces need to take a beating. Sealed porcelain over honed marble, brushed over polished, integrated drains.

downsizer.label: Downsizing — empty nester
downsizer.budget_posture: spending up for fewer remodels in their life
downsizer.voice_cue: downsizing — fewer square feet but more quality per. Walk-in shower with bench, soaking tub, warm finishes that won't date.

single_homeowner.label: Single homeowner
single_homeowner.budget_posture: varies widely — depends on home tenure
single_homeowner.voice_cue: designing for one means no compromise. Wherever they want to be bold, lean in.

senior_aging_in_place.label: Senior — aging in place
senior_aging_in_place.voice_cue: aging in place doesn't mean looking institutional. Comfort-height seat, grab bars in reach, walk-in shower with bench. Warm brushed finishes read homey, not medical.

diy_er.label: DIY-er — self-installing
diy_er.voice_cue: DIY install — prioritize standard 12in toilet rough-in, drop-in vs undermount sinks, prefabricated shower kits over custom tile. Save the splurge for finishes.

hiring_contractor.label: Hiring a contractor
hiring_contractor.budget_posture: labor cost shifts focus to material decision quality
hiring_contractor.voice_cue: with a pro install, the constraint is materials decision quality, not feasibility. Anything's possible — make it count.

pro_buying_for_client.label: Designer / pro buying for a client
pro_buying_for_client.voice_cue: you're the pro — give you the spec sheet, the lead time, the model number. Skip the consult-voice, lead with data.
